finding.trigger: Start prediction on server A, then Connect to server B before response A completes, or change servers after a completed result.
finding.outcome: Handler sets apiBase/rechecks health but never aborts inflight, increments seq, clears run/selected or clears tripId. A late A response can repopulate map while header/trips belong to B; old selected ID may not be allowed on B yet canRun becomes true.
finding.existing_guard_gap: chooseTrip has correct abort+seq+reset guard, but server URL change bypasses it; request callback can still pass mySeq===seq.current.
finding.fix: Use equivalent abort/seq/reset on server context change (trip/run/selected cleared); exercise delayed old-server response and disjoint new trip allowlist.

details.scope: No B source edits by A. Await pinned new B commit and clean integration retry for final ACK.
